findings.message: Stream 1 is encrypted, so its media objects cannot be analyzed; the stream is described by its header.

The file is protected by Windows Media DRM for network devices; a record names its objects in a way that is not a stream number, so every stream is taken to be encrypted and is reported as the file holds it.
An Encrypted Object Record has the ID type 0x0002; section 4.13 defines only 1, a stream number, so which object it covers is not known. The record is taken to cover every stream.
An Encrypted Object Record gives a stream number in 4 bytes; section 4.13 recommends 2 for type 1, a WORD. Which stream it names is not known, so the record is taken to cover every stream.
